findings.title: Descent becomes delivered speech
findings.claim: The focus presents sending as a relay in which what is sent down reaches its addressed hearers through messengers and repeated arrivals.
findings.mechanism: The focus forms أَرْسَلْنَا, رُسُلًا, and رَسُولٌۢ carry sending and messenger relations; 5:67 supplies reaching and sending-down forms as the independent delivery trigger. Their contact changes the focus from a bare report of dispatch into a bounded transmission whose endpoint is part of the reading.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the messenger sequence as the completion of a delivery path, while the focus remains a plain account of sending messengers and their reception.
findings.containment: This is a local pericope reading of delivery and descent; it does not establish a wider system or decide whether every nearby transmission shares the same structure.

epistemic.reason: The channel supports are trusted, but the three non-focus branches are nominated source images and the delivery relation remains an interpretive contact with the supplied focus surface.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The messenger is perceived as the carrier through whom the delivered content reaches its hearers.

findings.title: Binding taking beside instrumental taking
findings.claim: The focus's taking of the covenant is placed beside earlier taking forms that make allies, religion, or prayer serve a chosen use, so the local reading holds binding relation and instrumental appropriation together.
findings.mechanism: The focus أَخَذْنَا carries the supplied general taking branch, while the independent 5:57 and 5:58 اتَّخَذَ forms carry the self-directed acquisition branch. Their repeated root contact changes the covenant from an isolated promise into a relation seen against competing ways of making something one's own.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can sense why the covenant-taking carries relational weight within the nearby warnings about turning sacred or communal relations into instruments.
findings.containment: The contrast is a qualified local inference from the repeated taking root; it does not decide that every repetition has one deliberate rhetorical purpose.

epistemic.reason: The exact Arabic anchors and coordinates are supplied, but the HFT identity is legacy_unbound and its contrast remains an attributed contextual inference.

findings.title: Arrival as a diagnostic threshold
findings.claim: The focus's messenger arrival can also be perceived as a threshold where incoming content meets the receiver's concealed state, as 5:61 mirrors coming with entry, exit, and hidden disbelief.
findings.mechanism: جَآءَهُمْ is the focus carrier and the following بِمَا clause supplies carried content; the independent 5:61 coming, entering, exiting, and concealing coordinates turn arrival into an inside-outside contact. This changes a purely physical approach into a bounded diagnostic reading of what arrives and what the receiver carries.
findings.reader_payoff: The repeated arrival becomes a point at which reception is exposed, so the reader can see the encounter as testing the relation between public approach and inward content.
findings.containment: This is attributed contextual evidence with unresolved branch identity; it does not claim that 5:61 defines the focus's lexical sense or that concealment is the only result of arrival.

epistemic.reason: The HFT coordinates and exact Arabic anchors are supplied, while all five branch identities remain unresolved and therefore cannot receive invented glosses or facets.

findings.title: Repeated arrival inside an ignition circuit
findings.claim: The focus's whenever-pattern can be read as re-entering a recurring conflict circuit in which unwelcome communication becomes denial or killing, beside 5:64's repeated war ignition and external extinguishing.
findings.mechanism: كُلَّمَا and successive رُسُلٌ forms establish repeated inputs, while يَقْتُلُونَ supplies the focus's lethal output. The independent 5:64 كُلَّمَا, kindling, war, and extinguishing sequence contacts those forms and changes separate adverse responses into a repeated ignition pattern with restraint supplied from outside the response.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the focus's repetition as a patterned response loop, while its plain report of denial and killing remains intact.
findings.containment: The causal link between the two recurrence patterns is a qualified HFT inference; the finding does not assert that the parallel sequences are identical or that no other response is possible.

epistemic.reason: The trace has strong attributed support and exact supplied coordinates, but its unresolved branches and inferred causal contact require qualification.

findings.title: Covenant as transmission support
findings.claim: The focus covenant and messengers can be perceived as a support structure for protected transmission: what is sent down is conveyed through a carrier and must be established among its recipients.
findings.mechanism: مِيثَٰقَ carries the focus's solid covenant, while رُسُلًا and رَسُولٌۢ carry the human relay. The independent 5:66 establishment and 5:67 descent, delivery, and protection forms contact those carriers and change two historical acts into a maintained delivery structure whose rejection damages the recipient community's ability to establish what reaches it.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the covenant as load-bearing for the messenger relay while still hearing the plain focus claim that a covenant was taken and messengers were sent.
findings.containment: This is a qualified pericope reading limited to the supplied 5:66 and 5:67 contacts; it does not claim that every surrounding duty forms one system or that this structure replaces the plain historical reading.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has exact supplied coordinates and strong attributed support, while several supporting branch identities are unresolved or nominated rather than independently established.

findings.title: Preference can close reception
findings.claim: The focus's unwanted content meets an inward preference and self, while 5:71 makes the same reception problem visible as expectation of no test followed by blindness, deafness, restoration, and relapse.
findings.mechanism: تَهْوَىٰٓ and أَنفُسُهُمْ carry the preferred inward site of reception; the independent 5:71 expectation, testing, blindness, and deafness forms show recognition closing around that preference. This changes a conscious two-way response into an attributed possibility of sensory auto-closure before overt denial or killing.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the focus's disliked content as acting on an inner gate of reception, with the following ayah preserving the possibility of return and the danger of relapse.
findings.containment: This is a qualified attributed reading of the supplied focus-to-5:71 contact; it does not claim that blindness and deafness are always chosen defenses or that restoration guarantees permanence.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has exact focus and context coordinates, but its supporting branch identities are partly unresolved and its auto-protective inference remains attributed.
